name: KubSplit
fix_description: There are two setPair functions - one with onlyOwner and one without any access control. The unprotected setPair allows anyone to change the pair address, enabling pool manipulation. Fix: add onlyOwner to the unprotected setPair, or remove the duplicate.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC involves a long multi-stage attack chain with nested flash loans, AMM reserve manipulation, custom pair creation using an attacker-controlled fake token, staking reward abuse across multiple contracts, and repeated skim/sync interactions. Writing it requires deep protocol-specific understanding of the token/pair mechanics and reward accounting, well beyond a straightforward exploit.
